title: JouriEpi: A Dual-Engine Clinical Workstation and CRAN-Compliant R Library for Epidemiological Analysis
description: JouriEpi is an offline-first clinical epidemiology software ecosystem comprising a native PySide6 desktop workstation and the jouriepi base-R package. The Python engine provides 2x2 association measures and confidence intervals, exact tests, stratified analysis and heterogeneity diagnostics, diagnostic test accuracy and DeLong ROC comparisons, Fagan post-test probabilities, decision curve analysis, E-value sensitivity analysis, line-list cleaning and outbreak curves, and Cori-style instantaneous reproduction-number estimation. The native application supports local analysis, Word and LaTeX reporting, reproducibility scripts, and plot exports. The R package provides a scriptable statistical interface built on base R and stats, with documented functions, examples, and testthat coverage. Both components are designed for local/offline workflows; users remain responsible for their institutional privacy, security, and clinical validation requirements.
